name: Moerby
description_short: Hartenbos coffee shop and deli serving fresh pastries, hearty breakfasts, and quality coffee in a relaxed setting.
description_long:
Moerby has become a local favourite in Hartenbos for its warm, laid-back vibe and consistently good coffee. The café serves up freshly baked pastries, generous breakfasts, and light meals that hit the spot whether you're starting your day or taking a break from the beach. Their deli counter stocks local produce and takeaway treats worth browsing.

The space is casual and welcoming, perfect for a quick coffee run or a leisurely meal with friends. Located in the heart of Hartenbos, it's an easy stop for holidaymakers and locals alike. The friendly service and honest, well-prepared food keep people coming back — no fuss, just quality.
